LanguageData.MAP_SunEnergyCouplingBridge.label: Sun energy coupling bridge
LanguageData.MAP_SunEnergyCouplingBridge.description: An advanced energy coupling device designed specifically for Sun. It converts the enormous output of the antimatter reactor into a stable electrical supply and feeds it directly into the colony power grid through wireless power transmission. Once installed, Sun can still supply the colony with power while in mechanoid form.
